preconditions.description: The size of the array N must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of the parent array must be equal to N.
There must be exactly one root node with a value of -1 in the parent array.

postconditions.description: The output must be a space-separated string of node values in level order traversal of the constructed tree.
The root node of the constructed tree must not be None.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in nodes)
postconditions.description: All nodes in the constructed tree must be instances of the TreeNode class.
